This app is designed with your privacy first.

• On-device processing: your text, image, and voice input and the notes/events created from them are processed and stored only on your device, and are never sent to external servers.
• AI inference: runs entirely on your device. The AI model file is downloaded once; only the model file is transferred at that time (not your data).
• Speech recognition: uses your device's system speech recognition, subject to system policies.
• Permissions: used only for camera (photos), microphone (voice input), calendar (creating/editing events), notifications (alarms and morning briefing), and exact alarms.
• Storage and deletion: all data is kept in the app's on-device storage and is removed when you uninstall the app.
• No tracking or ads: the app performs no user tracking, advertising, or third-party analytics.
